    "Remove the duplicate 'Obiščite nas' and 'Delovni čas' section above the footer since those exact details are already prominently displayed in the hero section.",
    "Move the mobile sticky 'Pokličite / Navodila za pot' bar to the bottom of the viewport so it doesn't crowd the top header and compete with the main inquiry button.",
    "Remove the 'Nujni prevod v 24 urah' row from the services list, as the exact same 50% surcharge rule is already stated right above it under pricing."
